DIRECTING THE CLERK OF THE 
HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES 
TO MAKE A CORRECTION IN THE 
ENGROSSMENT OF H.R. 7147 
Mr. CISCOMANI. Mr. Speaker, I send 
to the desk a resolution and ask for its 
immediate consideration. 
The Clerk read the title of the resolu-
tion. 
The SPEAKER pro tempore. Is there 
objection to the request of the gen-
tleman from Arizona? 
There was no objection. 
The text of the resolution is as fol-
lows: 
H. RES. 1016 
Resolved, That the Clerk of the House of 
Representatives shall, in the engrossment of 
the bill H.R. 7147, make the following correc-
tion: In section 230(b), strike ‘‘in this Act or 
any other act’’ and insert ‘‘for the Depart-
ment of Homeland Security in this or any 
prior Act’’; and such correction shall be in-
corporated in the engrossment of H.R. 7148 
pursuant to House Resolution 1014. 
The resolution was agreed to. 
A motion to reconsider was laid on 
the table.
